Name: Better galaxy dagger
Author: BlancaMary
Description:
Sick of your stabbology master's degree going to waste because of the utter disrespect the vanilla game has for dagger users?
Does your hard earned galaxy dagger feels like a butter knife?
Have you spent 35k gold in a nearly useless thing and you feel dissapointed and having your day ruined?
Do sword and hammer users laught at you and makes you cry?
Do you feel like Marlon has scammed you?
WORRY NO MORE.
Your girl here has you covered, with this brand new galaxy dagger, every stab matters.
Go now to your closest Krobus store, and get this magnificent piece of art for only 50k gold (price increased to prevent people from getting it early and be too OP on the regular mines)
Why do Krobus sell it, and why does Marlon still sell the vanilla one? It's obviously to create a sense of progression, and not at all that I don't know how to replace it and it's easier to add a new weapon. Not at all.
What can this dagger do? Stab things.
Can I stab people with it? No. That's illegal.
I hope this mod can fulfill all your stabbing needs.
(It's my first mod and it definitely shows)
